name: Gmail
summary: Google describes AI-enhanced spam filtering as part of Gmail's protective systems.
limitation: This documents a particular protective feature, not all of Gmail or a model-by-model independent audit.

name: Google Maps
summary: Google explains its use of historical and live traffic data with machine-learning predictions in navigation.
limitation: Published product explanation; internal implementation and present-day configurations are not independently inspected.

name: Netflix
summary: Netflix Research explicitly identifies personalized recommendations as a machine-learning use case, while its Help Center explains member-facing ranking and preference signals.
limitation: Netflix documents ML use in recommendations, but does not reveal the exact model deployed for every ranking surface or member.

name: Visa
summary: Visa describes machine-learning-driven fraud risk assessment using transaction signals.
limitation: Vendor documentation supports deployment claims; false-positive rates and performance are not independently evaluated here.

name: FDA-listed devices
summary: The FDA documents authorized AI-enabled device categories, including diagnostic and imaging software.
limitation: This is a regulator-level category, not a single product; authorization does not imply zero risk or effectiveness for every use.
